reconciliationRule: Preserve the frozen initial eligible PR set independently. For an additional PR created within the frozen window, an explicit ready_for_review event at or before the cutoff establishes that the PR entered a non-draft state by the cutoff; because its creation is in-window, its first non-draft state cannot predate the window. The ready event timestamp is not asserted to be the exact first-ever non-draft transition. Missing or incomplete evidence remains uncertain. Do not infer historical state from current draft/status alone.

rows.uncertaintyReason: The first explicit ready_for_review event is within the window, but the PR was created before the window and the timeline has no opened event proving its initial draft state. No converted_to_draft event appears in the retained complete history; this absence does not establish that it was never non-draft before the window.
